_about: Generated by scripts/site/gen-plans.ts from deploy/cloudflare/src/plans.ts; do not edit. The checkout links are the ones GET /v1/plans gives.

free.free_key_note: An optional free key (emailed link, shown once, one active key per address) counts requests and registry lookups on its own meter instead of one shared per IP address: 60 requests a minute and 25 registry lookups a day per key, with all the free keys used from one IP address together held to 60 requests a minute and 100 lookups a day. Reports stay counted per IP address as well: 3 a month per email address, and the same 3 a month per IP address that calls without a key share.

paid_only.free: one parcel per call with the single-parcel tools

the account tools account_status and account_usage

paid_only_text: Eight things on the hosted API need a Pro or Team key: value history before the current roll year and superseded facts (registry_get, and the subject of registry_tx_equity_candidates); registry_get with as_of (a record on an earlier date); registry_tx_equity_candidates with tax_year (a roll year you name); a parcel's recorded sales, deeds and mortgages beyond the newest sale or deed (registry_get), and registry_recorded_facts; an owner's parcels beyond the first three (registry_owned_by, and registry_get on an entity); the registry batch tools registry_lookup_batch and registry_tx_equity_candidates_batch; the model-backed tools doc_extract_lease and report_narrative; and the account tools account_status and account_usage.
lookup_counted: A lookup is one call to a registry_* tool that finds something: a record, a resolved ID, owners or search results. Not counted: a call that finds nothing (an empty list or urn null; up to an hourly limit), registry_coverage, input errors, misses outside loaded coverage (county, state, entity registry or ID system not loaded) and calls the registry could not answer.
